title: Surreal Moonlit Portrait
description: A surreal composite face split into four distinct sections floats above a grassy field. The left side shows a purple crystalline night sky with a full moon and boat, the right side displays a vibrant orange sunset with a sailboat on water, while a large red crystalline maple leaf protrudes from the right and a golden moon with a black boat appears on the far left.
prompt: Surreal split portrait of a woman's lower face floating in a dreamy landscape, the circular head divided into four segments showing different times of day: dark purple night sky with full moon and boat on the upper left, vibrant orange sunset with sailboat on the right, a large faceted red maple leaf emerging from the right side, and a glowing golden moon with black boat on the far left, set against a starry night sky over a flower-filled meadow, highly detailed digital painting
